title: Customize Pattern Annotation | Clo Feature Deep Dive
description:
The new update to our Annotation feature in CLO 2025.0 allows you to set the orientation, size, and color of pattern annotations for quick and clear access to pattern information. Check out other new features here: https://www.clo3d.com/en/clo/features

Questions? Comment below or ask in our CLO discord server: https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/7814962429977-How-can-I-join-CLO-Discord?utm_campaign=multi_item_banner_JointheOfficialCLODiscord&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=later-linkinbio
